name: Caring For Children
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a precious heritage from the Lord, entrusted to us as His reward (Psalms 127:3). We are called to diligently train them in the ways of the Lord, ensuring they remain steadfast in faith throughout their lives (Proverbs 22:6). Jesus Himself emphasized the value of children, warning against despising them and highlighting their special place before God (Matthew 18:10; Mark 10:13). Furthermore, children are instructed to obey their parents as part of honoring God’s design for family relationships (Ephesians 6:1), all grounded in the overarching truth of God's love and salvation through Christ (John 3:16).
